purpose: Separate physical observer distance, display angular size and camera depth-of-field in a reproducible Blender Cycles scene.

activities.label: construct physical display, near plane, camera distance driver and focus offset driver
verify Cycles, explicit controls, no network and no external image dependency

queries.expression: does observer_distance_m change camera depth from the fixed monitor plane
does focus_offset_m select screen or near-plane focus without changing scene geometry
does the scene declare camera-optics simulation rather than human visual or comfort evidence

assumptions: The monitor is represented as a fixed 420 x 236.25 mm 16:9 plane.
The camera is a geometric observer proxy and is not a biological eye.
Cycles depth of field is useful for visualizing focal-plane separation but is not a clinical accommodation model.
No external image asset is needed for this first controlled scene.
kill_tests: Observer distance and focus offset must be separate explicit controls.
The script must not use network resources, input injection or external image assets.
A flat emissive screen must not be described as true stereoscopic depth.
Failure to observe changed angular size or changed DOF invalidates the visual experiment.
unknowns: Whether the simulated transition predicts a useful human sensory response.
Whether a real monitor can reproduce the same cue without stereoscopic hardware.
Whether the user's Blender Cycles device is configured for GPU rendering.
